suggested_workflows.name: Release qualification
suggested_workflows.description: Qualify one immutable source revision through deterministic tests, evidence custody, signed verdicts, staged promotion, and post-deploy proof.

suggested_workflows.description: Contain a certification, signing, runner, or evidence-custody incident without weakening trust boundaries or advancing an unverified revision.
